changelog.text: The enemy has advanced near Vozdvizhivka. The situation near Sadky has been clarified.
The enemy has advanced in Bilytske, as well as near Dorozhne and Novyi Donbas.
The enemy has advanced near Matyasheve.
The Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated Kolodyazi, Lypove, and Zelena Dolyna, and regained control of areas near Stavky and Shandryholove.
The enemy has advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka.
The enemy advanced near Matyasheve and Svitle.
The enemy has advanced near Novyi Donbas.
